cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler_proto import *
random.seed(42)
for case in range(20):
 n=random.choice([16,24,32,48])
 np=random.choice([4,8,12,16,24,32])
 np=min(np,n)
 C=sorted(random.sample(range(n),np))
 roots={v:random.choice([0,1,2,5,10,1000]) for v in C}
 if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[C[0]]=1
 D=sum(roots.values())
 # backbone plus random edges to 128
 links=[];used=set()
 for v in range(1,n):
  u=random.randrange(v);used.add(tuple(sorted((u,v))))
 links=[tuple(sorted(e)) for e in used]
 poss=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n) if (u,v) not in used]
 random.shuffle(poss)
 links += poss[:max(0,128-len(links))]
 # capacity per link high random to ensure likely feasible
 env={i:random.choice([D,D*2,D*5,10**12//max(1,D)]) for i in range(len(links))}
 p=random.choice([1,2,3,100])
 t=time.time();cut=find_deficient_cut(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 try:
  st,target=compile_plan(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
  if cut is not None:
   print('case',case,'denied',len(target),'time',round(time.time()-t,2));continue
  t2=time.time();validate_plan(target,n,links,C,roots,p,env)
  print('case',case,'n',n,'np',np,'D',D,'trees',len(target['trees']),'routes',len(target['routes']),'recipes',len(target['recipes']),'time',round(time.time()-t,2),round(time.time()-t2,2),flush=True)
 except Exception as e:
  if cut is not None: print('case denied',case);continue
  print('FAIL case',case,'n',n,'np',np,'cut',cut,repr(e));raise
print('done')
